# FromJson

Reads JSON text into a value.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
FromJson(text)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The JSON text to read. Comments and trailing commas are accepted. It must be a string: any other value, null included, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Any. The value the text describes: an object, an array, a string, a number, a boolean or null. Null when text is not JSON, holds a number too large to represent, or holds a string with an unpaired surrogate escape; null too when the text is the JSON literal `null`. Text that, read from its start, nests arrays or objects too deeply or passes the host's maximum value size before the point where it stops being JSON is a runtime error, not null.

## Example

`FromJson("{\"a\": [1, 2]}")` returns `{"a": [1, 2]}`.

`FromJson("not json")` returns null.
